senses.gloss:
The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् (when the object is in composition with it) the root taking the preposition आञ् and the sense of the word to be formed in inclination or accustomed occupation.

Terms: अच्

The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' when the word in composition is the उपसर्ग आण् and the semi-vowel of the root is changed into its corresponding vowel, when the word so formed means 'battle'.

Terms: अप्

धि is substituted for the Imperative affix हि when the tense-affix is not ङित्।

Terms: कित् and ङित्

Before the case-ending ओस् and before आ of the Instrumental -3rd case, ए is substituted for the final आ of the feminine affix.

Terms: गुण in Feminine
